name: menopause-skincare-starter
description: An interactive introduction to skin care in perimenopause, menopause and postmenopause: what menopause does to skin, hair and nails, what skin care can and cannot do, why the market is so confusing, how to judge the evidence behind a claim, and when to see a doctor or dermatologist. Evidence-based and informed by the personal experience of its creators, who are not medical or skin care professionals. Educational information only, not medical advice.
